findings.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $20.2 million, up 527% year over year, with gross profit of $3.3 million and gross margin of 16.1% (vs 12.7% in Q1 2026).
findings.source_title: Red Cat Reports Q2 2026 Revenue Growth of 527% Y/Y; Q2 Gross Margins Increase 39% vs Q2 2025

findings.claim: Q2 2026 operating loss was $38.6 million and net loss $35.3 million; six-month net loss was $61.8 million and net cash used in operating activities was $78.7 million, driven partly by a $49.9 million inventory build.
findings.source_title: Red Cat Holdings Form 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2026

findings.claim: Management reiterated full-year 2026 revenue target of $150-$180 million, describing 2026 as fundamentally a second-half story, and expects gross margin to approach 30% by year end.
findings.source_title: Earnings call transcript: Red Cat misses Q2 2026 estimates as stock falls 5.4%

findings.claim: With first-half 2026 revenue of ~$35.7 million against a $150-$180 million full-year target, the company would need roughly $114-$144 million in H2 2026, implying a steep ramp that carries execution risk.
findings.source_title: Red Cat Holdings Form 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2026

findings.claim: Teal Drones (Red Cat subsidiary) competed in the Close Quarters Battle portion of the Drone Dominance Program Gauntlet II and did not place in the top five; the program plans to buy ~60,000 drones from leaderboard vendors.
findings.source_title: Pentagon unveils top performers in latest 'Gauntlet' for Drone Dominance Program

findings.claim: Needham stated that Red Cat not receiving a Gauntlet II award may affect the company's full-year outlook; shares declined after the announcement. (Separately, Northland cut its target to $13 from $15 and trimmed FY26/FY27 estimates per TipRanks/The Fly.)
findings.source_title: Needham announces Drone Dominance Gauntlet II winners

findings.claim: The U.S. Army accounted for about 50% of first-half 2026 revenue, down from 73% in 2025; Japan was the second-largest customer, followed by the NATO Support and Procurement Agency.
findings.source_title: Earnings call transcript: Red Cat misses Q2 2026 estimates as stock falls 5.4%

findings.claim: In March 2026 a NATO ally selected the Black Widow sUAS via a competitive tender facilitated by NSPA, with an undisclosed number of systems scheduled for delivery during calendar 2026.
findings.source_title: Red Cat Secures New Orders for Black Widow Drones from NATO Ally

findings.claim: The U.S. Army SRR Tranche 2 limited-rate production contract signed July 2025 was expanded to approximately $35 million.
findings.source_title: Red Cat Holdings Reports Q3 2025 Revenue Growth of 646% Y/Y

findings.claim: In May 2026 Red Cat sold 23,936,171 shares at $9.40 plus a fully exercised 3,590,425-share underwriter option, for gross proceeds of ~$258.75 million (underwritten by Evercore and BofA under an S-3ASR shelf).
findings.source_title: Red Cat sells 3.59M option shares in offering | RCAT 8-K Filing

findings.claim: Company reports ~260k total sq. ft. of facilities (~5x vs 2024), ~1,200 drones shipped in Q4 2025, $325.6 million cash as of Q2 2026 with minimal debt, and $72 million LTM revenue as of Q2 2026.

The Q2 2026 10-Q discloses material weaknesses in internal control (insufficient resources, inadequate supervision/review and segregation of duties) and pending shareholder class action and derivative proceedings (e.g., Olsen v. Red Cat Holdings, D.N.J.).
findings.source_title: Red Cat Holdings Form 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2026

findings.claim: Red Cat is expanding into maritime autonomy via its Blue Ops USV division (Variant 7) and launched Hellcat, an internationally configurable variant derived from Black Widow.
findings.source_title: Earnings call transcript: Red Cat misses Q2 2026 estimates as stock falls 5.4%

findings.claim: Executive Order 14307 directs DoD to prioritize procurement of NDAA Sec. 848-compliant, U.S.-made drones and expand the Blue UAS list; Red Cat's FANG FPV drone was added to the Blue UAS Cleared List.
findings.source_title: Unleashing American Drone Dominance – The White House

key_risks.risk: Exclusion from Drone Dominance Gauntlet II leaderboard may reduce near-term program revenue; analysts trimmed FY26/FY27 estimates
Heavy second-half weighting of $150-$180M 2026 revenue target creates guidance-miss risk
Ongoing operating losses and cash burn ($78.7M operating cash outflow in H1 2026) with large inventory build
Material weaknesses in internal control and pending shareholder class action/derivative litigation
Repeated equity raises (four offerings Apr 2025-May 2026) dilute shareholders

dilution_events_last_12m.description: Underwritten offering of 23,936,171 shares at $9.40 plus full exercise of 3,590,425-share option; gross proceeds ~$258.75M

notes: Q2 2026 10-Q states management concluded the company has sufficient financial resources for at least the next twelve months; no going-concern language found. September 2025 offering (15.6M shares + 2.34M option at $9.60, ~$172.5M gross) falls just outside the 12-month window and is excluded from dilution list. Q3 2026 results not yet reported as of research date. Q2 press release/10-Q exact publication dates not shown in sources, so left null.
